tooling.message:
feat(app-publish): publish an app to its repo's GitHub Pages, checking the setup

## Intent

Each app lives at its developer's own hosting, and lernapps.net only links to it. The simple default is an action that deploys to the app repo's GitHub Pages. Later review environments need a gh-pages branch that Pages serves, so the action must ensure that setup or explain what is wrong.

## Key changes

- actions/app-publish wraps a script. Before the deploy it checks that gh-pages exists and that Pages serves it from its root; it sets this through the API when the token may, else it fails with what is wrong, the clicks in Settings, why, and the rule link. After the deploy it waits until the address serves this commit and prints it.
- The generated Pages workflow uses app-publish instead of site-deploy; the skill lernapps-app gets the rule pages-from-gh-pages.
- Tests run the script against a fake GitHub API and Pages; a workflow runs the check against this repo's real API.
- The architecture records dec-app-own-hosting, replaces the publishing actions block with "App publish", and makes the developer's GitHub Actions the deployment node.
- The plan template says: push a branch, merge after the checkpoint, watch the publish run, confirm the address.

tooling.message:
docs(arc42): blocks change with their prose; site actions out of scope

## Intent

The architecture review asks every block and the prose that explains it to change together. After the move to npx and App publish, several blocks no longer matched their prose.

## Key changes

- The generator's technology names npx from GitHub; the app check and app publish blocks name their paths; the new-app scenario names the npx scaffold and the publish step.
- The site actions are marked as outside the app tooling.

tooling.message:
docs(arc42): a small block for the site actions; deployment nodes match their prose

## Intent

The architecture review still warned: the actions that build and publish the lernapps.net sites belonged to no building block, and some deployment nodes did not match their prose.

## Key changes

- A small block for the site actions (site check, site deploy, site preview), used by the lernapps.net sites and not by apps, instead of leaving them out of scope.
- The creator's machine also hosts the runtime of app-templates; the agents' environment also runs the generator for evals.
